action: General advice: watch the Coles updates page, be wary of emails or calls claiming to be about the incident, and suppliers should verify any payment-detail changes by phone.
date_note: The day Coles disclosed the incident to the ASX; its updates page (current as at 16 November 2026, 8:30am) gives no earlier date for the incident.
exec: Coles says operations continue and it has found no evidence so far of compromised data, but the investigation is continuing.
plain: Australian supermarket group Coles says it is dealing with a cyber incident with help from the national cyber agency. Stores and online orders are running normally, and it has found no sign so far that data was taken.
summary: Coles told the ASX on 16 November it is investigating a cyber incident and working with the Australian Cyber Security Centre; iTnews adds it engaged global cyber security experts. Stores and online shopping operate normally, and Coles says it has not identified evidence so far that customer, team or supplier data was compromised or removed. Its updates page notes a small number of Liquorland click-and-collect issues under investigation.
title: Coles Group investigates cyber incident

validation.note: Coles' own updates page (current as at 16 November 2026, 8:30am; no later update seen on 22 November) plus iTnews and InDaily reporting the ASX statement.

review.note: stronger than source: removed 'second-largest' and 'major retailer' (not on pages), removed data-breach tag (no data compromise found); added iTnews published day; ASX/ACSC/no-evidence statement match Coles page and iTnews
